source.note: Official main build. 1c0654b7 is the merge of PR #114 (Slice-31 window: bounded App-tools subagents, Skill auto-selection and on-demand read, subagent continuation and write-after-check) on top of 770a2e27; the packed tree is the repository's public main branch at that merge, with no vendor patch and no dirty files.

steps: Use the public main commit 1c0654b749cf92c732603cc865638c6e532c4daa (the merge of PR #114 on 770a2e27).
node scripts/public-api.mjs and node scripts/quality-ratchet.mjs pass against that commit.
pnpm build; pnpm -C packages/sdk pack --pack-destination <isolated-directory>, run twice from two separate builds; the two archives are byte-for-byte identical.
Molis Work installs this archive through horizontal/agent-host's file: dependency; the lockfile records the same integrity.
build.note: This is the official dependency: the package is built from main after the Slice-31 PR merged, so it can be rebuilt from a public commit as-is. The previous custom window package stays recorded in patch-history.json as replaced.
